theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U N O : Set (Euclid P)) (pr : Euclid P → (Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P)) (X : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsOpen U → IsOpen O → N ⊆ O → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 pr O → (closure N \ N) ∩ U = ∅ → ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ U → ∃ XT : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 XT ∧ HasCompactSupport XT ∧ tsupport XT ⊆ U ∧ ∀ x ∈ N, XT =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun y => pr y (X y))
